standard_prerequisites: Base change of flatness of a module along morphisms of algebraic spaces
Existence of affine etale neighbourhoods of a point and of affine schemes surjective etale over a quasi-compact algebraic space
The scheme case: the freeness variant of the finite type flat along the fibre lemma for schemes
core_obligations: Choose an etale morphism (Y', y') -> (Y, y) with Y' an affine scheme, so that X x_Y Y' is quasi-compact
Choose an affine scheme X' surjective etale over X x_Y Y'; the pullback F' = g^*F is then flat over Y' at all points of the fibre X'_{y'} by base change of flatness

Apply the scheme case lemma to X' -> Y', g^*F, and y', obtaining an etale morphism (Y'', y'') -> (Y', y') with X'' affine etale over Spec(O_{Y'', y''}), |X''_{y''}| surjecting onto the fibre, and the pulled back module a free O_{Y'', y''}-module
Compose: the required diagram is (Y'', y'') -> (Y, y) together with the map X'' -> X given by g composed with g'
proof_roadmap: Etale localize the base once to make the base change quasi-compact, then cover it by an affine scheme surjective etale
Transfer flatness along the fibre by base change and apply the scheme case lemma
Compose the two etale steps into the final commutative diagram
difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is the existence of an etale neighbourhood with an affine etale cover whose module of sections is free over the local ring, at source lines 780-801, label lemma-finite-type-flat-along-fibre-free-variant, whose proof occupies source lines 803-832. The proof is a construction: the quasi-compactness check of the base change after the first etale localization, the choice of an affine surjective etale cover, the transfer of flatness along the fibre by base change, the application of the scheme case lemma, and the composition of the two etale steps into the final commutative diagram. The counted statement records none of this construction.
